subject: Moving the Legend Title in a Facet Plot

messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Moving the Legend Title in a Facet Plot
parts:
Dear All,
I am not exactly providing the most user-friendly snippet, but this is
what I am working on right now.
Please find it at the end of the email.
I am using ggplot2+ various packages to plot a map of Europe with various
countries colored according to a scalar (the yearly variation of gross
domestic product [GDP]).
It works well, but I cannot manage to reposition the legend title (which I
would like to be a bit further up).
In order to run the snippet, you need to download the map file from

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/5685598/TM_WORLD_BORDERS_SIMPL-0.3.zip

and unzip it in the same directory of the script, where you also need to
have the csv file you can get from

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/5685598/nama_gdp_k_1_Data.csv

Attempts to reposition the legend title inspired by


http://bit.ly/18JE4il
http://bit.ly/Iu1X2G
http://bit.ly/Iu1ZHV

did not work for me.
Any ideas?
Many thanks

Lorenzo

#####################################################################################àà

## see http://bit.ly/1aUavee
## see http://bit.ly/1bUWCt7 and
## see http://bit.ly/1eqpBrO
## see http://bit.ly/1bhTUD4
## see http://bit.ly/196swBW

library(maptools)
library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)
require(gpclib)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(grid)



gdp <- read.csv("nama_gdp_k_1_Data.csv", header=T)

gdp$GEO <- as.character(gdp$GEO)

sel <- which(gdp$GEO=="UK")

gdp$GEO[sel] <- "GB"

country_list <- unique(gdp$GEO) #ISO2 country codes

#replace the UK!





gpclibPermit()
worldmap <- readShapeSpatial("TM_WORLD_BORDERS_SIMPL-0.3.shp")
## worldmap <- readShapeSpatial("TM_WORLD_BORDERS-0.3.shp")

worldmap <- fortify(worldmap, region="ISO2")



#NB: remove the constraints on latitude and longitude to plot
# the whole world!!!

latlimits <- c(30, 75)
longlimits <- c(-15, 35)

time_seq <- unique(gdp$TIME)

wmap2 <- c()

for (k in seq(length(time_seq))){




sel_year <- time_seq[k]


sel <- which(gdp$TIME==sel_year)

gdp_yearly <- gdp[sel, ]

len <- length(worldmap$id)

worldmap$value <- rep(NA, len)
worldmap$year <- rep(sel_year, len)


for (i in seq(length(country_list))){

country <- country_list[i]

sel <- which(worldmap$id==country)

sel2 <- which(gdp_yearly$GEO==country)

gdp_val <- gdp_yearly$Value[sel2]

print("gdp_val is, ")
print(gdp_val)

## sel <- grep(country, worldmap$group)


worldmap$value[sel] <- rep(gdp_val,length(sel)) #regions
#are at 3 levels, and I need to make sure that I am giving the
#same value to every country as a whole (not just different values
# to different areas of the same country.)



}

wmap2 <- rbind(wmap2, worldmap)

## names(wmap2)[8] <- "GDP_growth"

}




gpl <- ggplot(wmap2, aes(long,lat,group=group)) +
## gpl <- ggplot(worldmap, aes(long,lat,group=id)) +
## facet_grid(~ year)+
facet_wrap( ~ year, nrow = 2## , scales = "free_y"
)+
geom_polygon(aes(fill=value)) +
## geom_polygon(fill = "darkseagreen") +

geom_polygon(data = wmap2, aes(long,lat),
fill=NA,
color = "black",
size=0.1) + # white borders
## scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", mid="darkgreen", high="blue")+
scale_fill_gradient("GDP % growth", low="white",
high="red",na.value="grey85",
breaks=seq(min(wmap2$value,
na.rm=T),max(wmap2$value, na.rm=T) , len=6 )
)+

## theme(legend.position="top") +
## coord_cartesian(xlim = longlimits, ylim = latlimits) +

coord_map("ortho", orientation=c(41.9, 12.5, 0),
xlim = longlimits, ylim = latlimits)+
labs(x=" ", y=" ")+
## theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
panel.grid.major=element_blank()) +
theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.y = element_blank())
## theme(panel.border = element_blank())
## guides(colour = guide_legend(title.vjust = -0.8))
## theme(legend.title = element_text(colour="red", size=8, face="bold",
vjust=6))

pdf("map.pdf",width=10,height=10)
print(gpl)
dev.off()
